olevel_requirement: Five (5) SSC credit passes including Music and English Language.
direct_entry: Two (2) 'A' Level passes to include Music.

institution_waivers.note: DE: accepts 'A' Level pass in Mathematics or other Arts or Social Science subjects. O'Level: accepts Music Society of Nigeria's Grade V certificate, Trinity College of Music Grade V certificate and Associated Board of Royal School of Music Grade V certificate and other Arts or Social Science subjects. UTME subject: requires any of Literature in English or CRS as the other subject.

DE: accepts (a) NCE in Music with merit pass and above, (b) DELSU Diploma in Music with merit pass and above, (c) ND in Music with upper credit and above; does not insist on 'O' Level credit pass in Music; both UTME and DE candidates must pass departmental audition. O'Level: requires five credits which may include Mathematics, English Language and four other subjects from Arts, Social Science and Science. UTME subject: requires three subjects from Arts, Social Science and Science.

DE: accepts (a) ND/HND upper credit in Music into 200 level, (b) 'A' Level pass in Music plus any other two 'A' Level subjects into 200 level, (c) NCE credit/merit Music major into 200 level, (d) Grade VIII Theory ABRSM or MUSON Certificate with any good HND or degree certificate into 200 level. O'Level: 'O' Level credit pass in Music is not compulsory. UTME subject: accepts any other three Arts or Social Science subjects.

DE: accepts Music major in relevant programme such as Theatre Arts, ND Music credit or NCE credit/merit in Music Education, IJMB 'A' Level in Music in addition to UTME requirements. O'Level: requires five 'O' Level credit passes to include English Language, Literature in English and any Arts/Social Science subjects at not more than two sittings.

DE: accepts (a) NCE merit in Music Education, Music Technology/Music, (b) ND Music/Music Technology, (c) (a) and (b) in addition to five 'O' Level credit passes at not more than two sittings to include English Language and any combination of Arts and Sciences. UTME subject: accepts Music plus any two (2) other subjects.

DE: accepts passes in three (3) subjects including Music: (a) NCE credit in Music, (b) ABRSM London Grade VIII (theory and practical) or equivalent, (c) Diploma in Music at upper credit from OAU or any other recognized higher institution. O'Level: accepts English Language, one Arts or Humanities subject and three from Biology, Physics, Chemistry, ICT, Economics, Geography, Agricultural Science, Accounting, Mathematics; requires 'O' level credit passes in another Language, African or European; credit pass in Music not compulsory. UTME subject: accepts any three (3) subjects from Arts, Social Sciences or Sciences.

DE: accepts at least two A/Level passes in GCE, HSC, JUPEB or IJMB in any two Arts subjects, Music single or double major with overall merit from a College of Education, Grade 8 (Theory and Practical) of ABRSM or MUSON, Licentiate Certificate, or Diploma from Department of Music University of Port Harcourt, all including UTME entry requirements. O'Level: requires five SSC credits in English Language and any other four from Music, Literature in English, History/Government, CRK/IRK, Economics, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, Agricultural Science, Physics, Igbo/Hausa/Yoruba, Fine Art, Geography, Commerce. UTME subject: requires any three (3) subjects from the listed set.

DE: accepts (a) for three years: NCE single/double major and ND in Music, Music Society of Nigeria's Grade V Certificate, Trinity College of Music Grade V certificate, ABRSM Grade V certificate; (b) for two years: NCE merit double major in Music Education. O'Level: requires candidates to pass Audition held on the last Thursday and Friday of August every year. UTME subject: accepts any three (3) subjects.

DE: accepts ND. O'Level: does not insist on a credit pass in Music at 'O' Level; a Grade V certificate in ABRSM or MUSON is an added advantage; requires candidates to pass Audition held on the last Thursday and Friday of August every year.

DE: Post NCE and Post Diploma in Music/Music Education (3 years). O'Level: requires 'O' Level credit passes at GCE, WAEC/SSCE or NECO in five subjects: English Language and Mathematics and any three from CRS, History, Literature in English, Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Integrated Science, Commerce, Government, Economics, Physical and Health Studies, Technical Studies. UTME subject: requires English Language and any three from the same list.

DE: in addition to 'O' Level requirements requires (i) Two 'A' Level passes including Music, (ii) JUPEB Music, (iii) OND with minimum Upper Credit, (iv) NCE (Music Major) not less than Merit, (v) minimum Grade 7 Certificate from ABRSM, MIMS, MUSON or TCM; Conversion Programme (3rd year) considers Distinction in Music at HND or Diploma from ABRSM, MIMS, MUSON, TCM or other recognized institutions. O'Level: requires five 'O' Level SSC credit passes at not more than two sittings to include English Language and four subjects from Social Sciences, Arts and Natural Sciences (Music credit desirable, not mandatory); a minimum Grade 5 Certificate of ABRSM/MIMS/MUSON/TCM accepted as equivalent of an SSC Music credit pass. UTME subject: requires any three subjects.
O'Level: does not require 'O' Level credit pass in Music but accepts 'O' Level pass in English Language. UTME subject: accepts any three (3) Arts or Social Science subjects; Music is not compulsory.
